title: confiture migrate validate --format json (two or more checks)
description: Wrapper emitted when one `migrate validate` invocation runs more than one check (0.40.0, #187). A single-check invocation keeps emitting that check's own documented payload verbatim and never matches this schema — the wrapper exists precisely so the single-check shapes stay byte-for-byte stable. Each value under `checks` is the payload the same check would have emitted on its own, keyed by the check's stable machine name.

version.description: Envelope version. Bumped only if the wrapper's own shape changes; the nested per-check payloads carry their own contracts.

status.description: `failed` when any check that ran reported a finding. The process exit code is 1 in that case, 0 otherwise.

checks.description: One entry per check that produced output, keyed by stable check name. Keys are exactly the names below; the set present depends on which flags were passed.

^[a-z_]+$.description: The check's single-check payload, unchanged. See the per-check schema files for the documented ones (migrate-validate-check-acl-coverage, -check-function-uniqueness, -idempotent, -grant, -list-patterns).
